_comment: Reports v3 WS-A3: WHY raw event counts differ from portal-indexed counts. Rendered as the parity legend — policy lives here (config), not in lore. Classes not listed follow the default.
default: indexed — every raw row routes to exactly one portal category (no day window on the index)

classes.hermes_rank_surge: aggregates-only by design — 65% of all raw alert volume (v1 WS-D finding); individual surge rows would bury the archive, so analytics counts them raw and the archive carries only daily digests
classes.data_staleness: indexed individually; research-gap topic rows are visibility-only (no agent jobs since 2026-07-17 queue-starvation fix)
classes.pipeline_critical: indexed individually — failure rail feeds the System rollup
classes.telegram_outbox: delivery ledger only — parity line, never archive rows
classes.notification_log: delivery ledger only — parity line, never archive rows
